windows.60: Visitors have noted issues with the food quality, particularly that some dishes lack flavor and the menu options are limited. Several reviews mention dissatisfaction with the service, including the refusal to provide cups for water. Wait times have also been brought up as a concern by multiple visitors. While some appreciate the healthier food choices, the overall value and atmosphere received minimal attention. Addressing these areas could improve the visitor experience.
windows.90: Over the last 90 days, several visitors have expressed concerns about the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Common issues include limited menu options, inconsistent food quality, and high prices that many found not justified by portion size or taste. Some guests reported long wait times and periods when ordering was unavailable due to kitchen delays. While a few appreciated the healthy choices, overall satisfaction with the dining experience was mixed, with particular dissatisfaction around value and service. Addressing these areas could improve visitor experience.
